A courageous martyr
2017-01-07T00:00:00+06:00 | Mahbub Newaz Chowdhury
https://www.thedailystar.net/literature/news/courageous-martyr-1341364

Faraaz is our proven brave heart We are proud We are bleeding, still heart-broken, Unable to accept his loss Such a young brave heart.

Faraaz is in our heart With our love for him We cannot bear such a sad demise.

Forgive us, Faraaz, you gave us your life We could not save you But we will save your values Your martyrdom will not be forgotten.

Long live the memory of our valiant Faraaz. Let us all gather to salute his heroism to uphold human values and highest moral. We are filled with pride and uplifted by his unparalleled valour and compassion to save his friends from savage militants.

Faraaz raised the banner of righteousness in our country and our world. An icon of chivalry and altruism A knight in shining armour in our resolve to resist barbarism. Let his spirit light our minds and hearts in gratitude and remembrance of his supreme sacrifice.

The poem is a tribute to Faraaz Hossain, whose martyrdom heralded a reawakening of humanity amongst us.
